class.name: OcgGraphic3dMaterialaspect
class.brief_description: This class allows the definition of the type of a surface. Aspect attributes of a 3d face. Keywords: Material, FillArea, Shininess, Ambient, Color, Diffuse, Specular, Transparency, Emissive, ReflectionMode, BackFace, FrontFace, Reflection, Absorption
class.description: ! This class allows the definition of the type of a surface. ! Aspect attributes of a 3d face. ! Keywords: Material, FillArea, Shininess, Ambient, Color, Diffuse, ! Specular, Transparency, Emissive, ReflectionMode, ! BackFace, FrontFace, Reflection, Absorption

method.name: default
method.description: Creates a material from default values.

method.name: from_2
method.description: Creates a generic material.

method.name: Name
method.description: Returns the material name (within predefined enumeration).

method.name: RequestedName
method.description: Returns the material name within predefined enumeration which has been requested (before modifications).

method.name: MaterialName_1
method.description: Returns the given name of this material. This might be:

method.name: Color
method.description: Returns the diffuse color of the surface. WARNING! This method does NOT return color for Graphic3d_MATERIAL_ASPECT material (color is defined by Graphic3d_Aspects::InteriorColor()).

method.name: SetColor
method.description: Modifies the ambient and diffuse color of the surface. WARNING! Has no effect for Graphic3d_MATERIAL_ASPECT material (color should be set to Graphic3d_Aspects::SetInteriorColor()).

method.name: Transparency
method.description: Returns the transparency coefficient of the surface (1.0 - Alpha); 0.0 means opaque.

method.name: Alpha
method.description: Returns the alpha coefficient of the surface (1.0 - Transparency); 1.0 means opaque.

method.name: SetTransparency
method.description: Modifies the transparency coefficient of the surface, where 0 is opaque and 1 is fully transparent. Transparency is applicable to materials that have at least one of reflection modes (ambient, diffuse, specular or emissive) enabled. See also SetReflectionModeOn() and SetReflectionModeOff() methods.

method.name: SetAlpha
method.description: Modifies the alpha coefficient of the surface, where 1.0 is opaque and 0.0 is fully transparent.

method.name: AmbientColor
method.description: Returns the ambient color of the surface.

method.name: SetAmbientColor
method.description: Modifies the ambient color of the surface.

method.name: DiffuseColor
method.description: Returns the diffuse color of the surface.

method.name: SetDiffuseColor
method.description: Modifies the diffuse color of the surface.

method.name: SpecularColor
method.description: Returns the specular color of the surface.

method.name: SetSpecularColor
method.description: Modifies the specular color of the surface.

method.name: EmissiveColor
method.description: Returns the emissive color of the surface.

method.name: SetEmissiveColor
method.description: Modifies the emissive color of the surface.

method.name: Shininess
method.description: Returns the luminosity of the surface.

method.name: SetShininess
method.description: Modifies the luminosity of the surface. Warning: Raises MaterialDefinitionError if given value is a negative value or greater than 1.0.

method.name: IncreaseShine
method.description: Increases or decreases the luminosity.

method.name: RefractionIndex
method.description: Returns the refraction index of the material

method.name: SetRefractionIndex
method.description: Modifies the refraction index of the material. Warning: Raises MaterialDefinitionError if given value is a lesser than 1.0.

method.name: BSDF
method.description: Returns BSDF (bidirectional scattering distribution function).

method.name: SetBSDF
method.description: Modifies the BSDF (bidirectional scattering distribution function).

method.name: PBRMaterial
method.description: Returns physically based representation of material

method.name: SetPBRMaterial
method.description: Modifies the physically based representation of material

method.name: ReflectionMode
method.description: Returns TRUE if the reflection mode is active, FALSE otherwise.

method.name: MaterialType_1
method.description: Returns material type.

method.name: MaterialType_2
method.description: Returns TRUE if type of this material is equal to specified type.

method.name: SetMaterialType
method.description: Set material type.

method.name: IsDifferent
method.description: Returns TRUE if this material differs from specified one.

method.name: IsEqual
method.description: Returns TRUE if this material is identical to specified one.

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream

method.name: SetReflectionModeOff
method.description: Deactivates the reflective properties of the surface with specified reflection type.

method.name: not_equal
method.description: Returns TRUE if this material differs from specified one.

method.name: equal
method.description: Returns TRUE if this material is identical to specified one.

method.name: NumberOfMaterials
method.description: Returns the number of predefined textures.

method.name: MaterialName_2
method.description: Returns the name of the predefined material of specified rank within range [1, NumberOfMaterials()].

method.name: MaterialType_3
method.description: Returns the type of the predefined material of specified rank within range [1, NumberOfMaterials()].

method.name: MaterialFromName_1
method.description: Returns the material for specified name or Graphic3d_NameOfMaterial_DEFAULT if name is unknown.
